subject: Private environment expansion ahead of renewal — capacity & isolation plan
messages:
From: Maya Singh <m.singh@bluebridgehealth.com>
To: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@bluebridgehealth.com>, procurement@bluebridgehealth.com
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Private environment expansion ahead of renewal — capacity & isolation plan

Hi Ethan,

We're starting to plan our Redwood renewal in mid-August and want to fold in an expansion and stronger isolation model for our analytics workloads. High-level ask:

- Provision a new EU private environment (VPC) isolated from our existing prod cluster.
- Two clusters (3 nodes each) with GPU capacity roughly equivalent to 6 x A40-class instances, plus room to burst.
- 24-month term for the private environment (we'd like longer-term pricing).
- KMS integration for customer-managed keys and extended audit log retention (18 months).

Attached is a first-pass SOW that our infra team sketched. Can you confirm whether this is feasible on your end and provide an initial timeline and ballpark pricing? Also please flag anything we missed on compliance or networking requirements.

Thanks — we want to lock this in before the renewal window.

Maya Singh
VP of Platform Operations
BlueBridge Health
Attachment: BlueBridge_SOW_draft_v1.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Singh <m.singh@bluebridgehealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, PrIyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private environment expansion ahead of renewal — capacity & isolation plan

Hi Maya — thanks for the clear brief and the SOW. This is doable and we should be able to meet the isolation and KMS requirements, but I'll need to confirm a few items with infra and pricing. Next steps from our side:

1) I'll loop in Kimberly to produce two pricing options (24-month commit with discount tiers + a 12-month alternative).
2) PrIyom will scope the provisioning timeline and the operational runbook for cutover and data migration.
3) Can you share current 30/90-day token and throughput baselines for the clusters so we size burst correctly? Also confirm preferred EU region (Frankfurt vs. Amsterdam) and whether you require dedicated hardware vs. shared private pools.

I'll come back with an internal MAP and a strawman timeline by EOB Thursday.

—Ethan
Ethan Park
Account Lead, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 09:30:00 -0700

Maya / Ethan — preliminary pricing options below (very high level; I will produce a formal quote once PrIyom confirms node sizing and region).

Option A (24-month private term, reserved capacity):
- 6 GPU-equivalent nodes (2 clusters of 3) – baseline monthly commit: €46,000/month
- 18% discount applied for 24-month commit
- Included: standard audit logs (12 months), optional KMS add-on (+€1,200/month)

Option B (12-month with burst credits):
- 6 GPU-equivalent nodes – €54,000/month
- Burst credits priced separately; no term discount

If you want dedicated hardware (single-tenant hosts) add ~12% CAPEX premium; if shared private pools are acceptable we maintain the pricing above.

I'll wait on the region selection — EU-FRA has marginally lower latency for your EU users, but EU-AMS gives us slightly more scheduling flexibility for availability.

Kimberly Park
Sr. Pricing Manager, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Private environment expansion ahead of renewal — capacity & isolation plan

Hi all — quick security/compliance notes as you evaluate the SOW:

- KMS: We support AWS KMS customer-managed keys and HSM-backed key stores for on-prem gateways. We'll need the key policy and the admin list before provisioning.
- Audit logs: We can extend retention to 18 months as requested, but that increases storage logs costs (~€600/month incremental for the scale you described).
- Data residency: For EU deployments we will confirm cross-region fallback rules (DR) and whether logs can leave the EU — if not, we need to pin DR to another EU zone.
- Network isolation: Ensure we have the BlueBridge public IP ranges and peering JV details; our network team will generate a firewall/route template.

Attached: snapshot of our SOC2 artifacts you can share with your auditors.

Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachment: BBH_SOC2_snapshot_2027.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Maya Singh <m.singh@bluebridgehealth.com>
To: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@bluebridgehealth.com>, procurement@bluebridgehealth.com
Date: Fri, 23 Jul 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private environment expansion ahead of renewal — capacity & isolation plan

Thanks — we prefer EU-FRA for the new environment and would like the 24-month term if the price sits within ~15% of our current total cost.

For sizing: last 30 days average token throughput is ~220M tokens/day across analytics; peak concurrency maps to roughly 80 rps sustained for 90-minute blocks. We can provide a CSV with detailed traces if you need them.

Procurement contact: procurement@bluebridgehealth.com (they will drive contract redlines).

Please go ahead and propose a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with milestones for procurement, SOC/pen test evidence, provisioning, and cutover. We need the MAP to present to our board on Aug 3.

Maya
